title: D-024 F: operator channel (one-command start, status, zero-context /loop-* commands, ask-Codex)
objective: Expose the owner surface on the existing supervisor CLI: canonical idempotent no-duration start (documented 'Start the agent loop' intent/alias; running campaign reported, never duplicated), status/current-task/checkpoint/health reporting per section 14 (concise default, verbose/JSON diagnostics, notification-sink interface with terminal implementation only - no email/credentials), durable pause/resume/graceful-stop/emergency-stop acknowledged only after durable state update, and a new 'ask' operation delivering bounded owner questions to the read-only Codex supervisor (short response window, durable request ID fallback). Add feature-detected pre-model /loop-* interception inside Claude Code (user-only skills/commands; UserPromptExpansion preferred, UserPromptSubmit block/display/erasure otherwise; exact-match only, safe argument/stdin handling, secrets/terminal-escape redaction, bounded I/O, timeouts without zombie duplicates) and PROVE zero Fable-context pollution on the installed version - or truthfully document the second-terminal CLI fallback; test while idle and while a response is active; queued slash input must not be advertised as real-time control. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R104 (Phase F). (Amendment 3 conversion, M0-T102 accepted: implement as thin skills with disable-model-invocation:true calling the external supervisor directly (R158) + narrowly matched UserPromptExpansion interception with zero-model-context proof or the honest second-terminal fallback (R159); no collision with built-in /loop; G5 unit-G security preconditions apply; sensitive controls not advertised to Remote Control/SDK command lists.)
business_reason: D-024 sections 4, 11, 14, 15-F, 16.5: the owner needs real control and truth about what is happening without polluting the producer's context.
outputs: canonical start/status/control/ask CLI operations on the existing supervisor command surface
feature-detected /loop-* pre-model interception (or documented truthful fallback) with zero-context proof
tools/test_agent_supervisor_operator_channel.py (section 16.5 matrix incl. metacharacter/Unicode safety, timeout single-request, hook fail-closed)
